title: Check, checkmate and stalemate
summary: How a game is won - and drawn.

steps.text:
A king that is attacked is in **check**, and the player must get out of check at once: move the king, block the attack, or capture the attacker.

If none of those is possible it is **checkmate** and the game is over. If a player is *not* in check but has no legal move, it is **stalemate**: a draw. So when you are winning, always leave the enemy king a move!

steps.hint: Black's own pawns stop the king from escaping. Attack along the back rank.
